name: agent-orch
description: Stage-first orchestration with catalog-based recommended routes, bounded Worker upgrades, quota-only reviewer fallback, environment audits, concise events, reviewed integration, exact Git commits and a local Auditor.

interface.shortDescription: Recommend routes and supervise bounded worker/reviewer retries.
interface.longDescription: Choose catalog-based recommended routes, edit selected tiers, or customize. Plan and Accept stay in the current host; approved Codex Worker upgrades preserve partial work and evidence, and AGY reviewers fall back only for quota. Audit inherited Git changes, supervise concise events, independently review and accept changes, integrate parallel results, commit exact task changes and safely retire worktrees. Inspect plans and Git history in the bilingual local Auditor. Preserve unrelated edits and durable evidence. Hooks do not wake idle chats.
defaultPrompt: Recommend current stage models, let me use, edit or customize the matrix, and initialize Git policies while preserving existing changes.
Implement and independently review this task, then finalize its exact local commit and safely retire its worktree while preserving unrelated edits.
Integrate accepted parallel task results, independently review and accept the combined patch, then commit and clean up.
